term: the respect in which a thing's necessity consists (NecessityConsistsIn x r)
definition: NecessityConsistsIn x r: the necessity of x is the necessity of x's being r, so that whatever makes x r makes x necessary in that respect. The open premise STMT-NECESSITY-CONSISTS-IN-BEING takes r to be esse for every necessary being (the tertia via's 'necessity of its being'). It is not itself a causal relation; the open premise STMT-CAUSING-NECESSITY-RESPECT-CAUSES-NECESSITY links it to CausesNecessityOf. In Lean a parameter B -> R -> Prop.
